plan.family: A (3-SAT, n=16, ratio 4.0); all other settings as in the reported study
plan.comparators: stored runs of the reported study (partial-supervision matrix at f=0.005, main matrix), which share code, data, seeds and supervised subsets

answer_supervision.labels: for each training instance one conclusion literal (variable uniform, polarity uniform; numpy default_rng(0)), labelled True / False / Unknown by the complete DPLL solver of Cell 5 (F entails c / F entails not-c / neither)
answer_supervision.loss: cross-entropy of kappa*(D, -D, mu - |D|) with D = (m+1)*(S(C+c) - S(C+not c)), where S is the relaxed layer's mean clause satisfaction on the emitted formula augmented with the unit clause; kappa = 4, mu = 0.5; class weights = inverse label frequency
answer_supervision.rationale: the natural-language surrogate uses the unscaled difference, which is bounded by 1/(m+1) and makes Unknown the arg-max by construction; the (m+1) rescaling removes that bound. mu was fixed on GOLD formulas of 1,000 training instances before any Plan III training (balanced accuracy of the surrogate's arg-max on gold formulas 0.61 at mu = 0.5, against 0.33 for chance). Label shares on the full training set: True 0.236, False 0.243, Unknown 0.521

A2_ST.note: answers through the solver on all instances + per-slot supervision on 100 instances, vs per-slot supervision only

A2_soft.note: as A2_ST with the soft bridge

plan.confirmatory_rule: one-sided exact sign-flip permutation test on the per-seed differences (all 2^12 sign patterns); Holm over {A2_ST, A2_soft} at alpha = 0.05; SUPPORTED iff Holm-adjusted p < 0.05 AND mean difference >= 0.03
plan.secondary_confirmatory: success indicator (faith_excess_id > 0.30): exact one-sided McNemar; non-superiority: a benefit >= 0.03 is excluded iff the upper limit of the t-based 90% interval of the mean difference is < 0.03

A1_ST.compare: no_faith (gold formula through the anchored loss)

D.compare: SATLM-frozen, LogicLM-frozen, majority floor; accuracy and abstention

plan.diagnostic_rule: estimates with 95% t intervals, exact two-sided sign-flip p-values and minimum detectable differences; no verdicts (6 seeds cannot reach significance after correction)
